gemini.title: Flood Zones 2 and 3 - Rivers and Sea
gemini.abstract: Modelled Flood Zone 2 and Flood Zone 3 extents showing land at risk from flooding from rivers or the sea, without accounting for defences.
gemini.lineage: Published by Environment Agency as open environmental data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: origin
columns.description: Evidence or modelling source used to define the flood-zone extent.

columns.name: flood_zone
columns.description: Flood-zone class, such as FZ2 or FZ3.

columns.name: flood_source
columns.description: Source of flooding represented, such as river, sea or surface water.

columns.name: objectid
columns.description: Source-system row identifier; useful internally but not guaranteed to remain stable between data releases.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.
